items.source:
Leverage the T type of TypedPropertyPath: Whenever accepting a typed property path, consider using the generic type T of TypedPropertyPath<T, P>. Limiting property paths to a specific domain type that is used within the current operation reduces the potential of using unintended properties from other types.

Whenever accepting or providing multiple property paths, consider using TypedPropertyPath<T, ?> to allow for properties within the context of the owning type T to limit property paths to a common owning type.
items.translation:
利用 TypedPropertyPath 的 T 类型：每当接受一个类型化的属性路径时，应考虑使用 TypedPropertyPath<T, P> 的泛型类型 T。将属性路径限制在当前操作中使用的特定领域类型内，可降低意外使用其他类型的属性的风险。

每当接受或提供多个属性路径时，应考虑使用 TypedPropertyPath<T, ?>，以便在所属类型 T 的上下文中允许属性，从而将属性路径限制为共同的所属类型。

items.source: The org.springframework.data.core package is the basis for Spring Data’s navigation across domain classes. The TypeInformation interface provides type introspection capable of resolving the type of a property. PropertyPath represents a textual navigation path through a domain class.
items.translation: `org.springframework.data.core` 包是 Spring Data 在域类之间进行导航的基础。`TypeInformation` 接口提供了类型内省功能，能够解析属性的类型。`PropertyPath` 则代表了一个通过域类的文本导航路径。

items.source: While a property path is a simple representation of object navigation, String-based property paths are inherently fragile during refactoring as they can be easily missed with an increasing distance between the property definition and its usage. Type-safe alternatives through TypedPropertyPath derive property paths from method references, enabling the compiler to validate property names and IDEs to support refactoring operations.
items.translation: 虽然属性路径是对象导航的简单表示形式，但基于字符串的属性路径在重构过程中本质上很脆弱，因为随着属性定义与其使用位置之间距离的增加，它们很容易被遗漏。 通过 TypedPropertyPath 提供的类型安全替代方案可以从方法引用派生属性路径，使编译器能够验证属性名称，并让 IDE 支持重构操作。

items.source: Use method references: Accept method references (e.g., Person::getFirstName) instead of strings to leverage compile-time validation and IDE refactoring support. Method references are preferred as they share similar representations with both Java and Kotlin. Additionally, method references provide a better performance baseline compared to lambdas due to their simpler representation.
items.translation: 使用方法引用：接受方法引用（例如 Person::getFirstName）而非字符串，以利用编译时验证和 IDE 重构支持。 方法引用是首选方案，因为它们与 Java 和 Kotlin 具有相似的表示形式。 此外，由于方法引用的表示更为简单，其性能基准优于 lambda 表达式。

items.source: A property path consists of one or more segments separated by a dot (.). Methods accepting property paths support single-segment references (top-level properties) and multi-segment navigation unless otherwise indicated.
items.translation: 属性路径由一个或多个通过点（.）分隔的段组成。 除非另有说明，否则接受属性路径的方法支持单段引用（顶级属性）和多段导航。

items.source: Flexibility: Property paths are flexible and can be constructed from constant string, configuration or as result of user input.
items.translation: 灵活性：属性路径具有灵活性，可由常量字符串、配置或用户输入的结果构建而成。

items.source: Untyped: String paths do not carry compile-time type information. Typed as textual content they do not have a dependency on the underlying domain type.
items.translation: 未类型化：字符串路径不携带编译时类型信息。作为文本内容，它们不依赖于底层域类型。

items.source: Refactoring risk: Renaming domain properties requires often manual updates to string literals; IDEs cannot reliably track these references.
items.translation: 重构风险：重命名领域属性通常需要手动更新字符串字面量；IDE 无法可靠地追踪这些引用。

items.source: To improve refactoring safety and type consistency, prefer type-safe property references using method references. This approach associates property paths with compile-time type information and enables compiler validation and IDE-driven refactoring. See Type-safe Property-References for details.
items.translation: 为提高重构安全性和类型一致性，建议使用方法引用来实现类型安全的属性引用。 此方法将属性路径与编译时类型信息关联起来，支持编译器验证和 IDE 驱动的重构操作。 有关详细信息，请参阅类型安全的属性引用。

items.source:
This chapter covers the concept of property paths.
Property paths are a form of navigation through domain classes to apply certain aspects in the context of interacting with the model.
Application code provides property paths to data access components to express intents such as selection of properties within a query, forming predicates, or applying sorting.
A property path originates from its owning type and can consist of one to many segments.
items.translation:
本章介绍属性路径的概念。  
属性路径是一种在领域类之间导航的形式，用于在与模型交互的上下文中应用某些方面。  
应用程序代码向数据访问组件提供属性路径，以表达诸如在查询中选择属性、形成谓词或应用排序等意图。  
属性路径从其拥有类型开始，可以包含一个或多个段。

Following domain-driven design principles the classes that form the backbone of your persistent domain model and that are accessed through Spring Data are called entities.
An entry point to the object graph is called aggregate root.
items.translation:
遵循领域驱动设计原则，构成持久化领域模型主干并通过 Spring Data 访问的类被称为实体。  
对象图的入口点称为聚合根。

items.source: Understanding how to navigate and reference these properties is essential for working with repositories and query operations.
items.translation: 了解如何导航和引用这些属性对于操作仓储和查询至关重要。

items.source:
Property paths provide a simple, text-based mechanism to navigate domain model properties.
This section introduces the fundamentals of property path navigation and demonstrates trade-offs between string-based and type-safe approaches.
items.translation: 属性路径提供了一种基于文本的简单机制，用于导航领域模型属性。本节介绍属性路径导航的基础知识，并演示字符串基础方法与类型安全方法之间的权衡。

items.source:
Type-safe property-references eliminate a common source of errors in data access code: Brittle, string-based property references.
This section explains how method references can be used to express refactoring-safe property paths.
items.translation: 类型安全的属性引用消除了数据访问代码中一个常见的错误来源：脆弱且基于字符串的属性引用。本节将解释如何使用方法引用来表达可重构安全的属性路径。

items.source: Type-safe property paths integrate seamlessly with query abstractions and criteria builders, enabling declarative query construction without string-based property references.
items.translation: 类型安全的属性路径与查询抽象和标准构建器无缝集成，支持通过声明式方式构建查询，而无需使用基于字符串的属性引用。

items.source:
Adopting type-safe property references aligns with modern Spring development principles.
Providing declarative, type-safe, and fluent APIs leads to simpler reasoning about data access eliminating an entire category of potential bugs through IDE refactoring support and early feedback on invalid properties by the compiler.
items.translation:
采用类型安全的属性引用符合现代 Spring 开发原则。  
提供声明式、类型安全且流式的 API，能够简化对数据访问的推理，通过 IDE 重构支持和编译器对无效属性的早期反馈，消除一整类潜在的 bug。

items.source:
Lambda introspection is cached for efficiency enabling repeatable use.
The JVM reuses static lambda instances contributing to minimal overhead of one-time parsing.
items.translation: Lambda 的内省机制会被缓存以提高效率，从而支持重复使用。JVM 会复用静态 Lambda 实例，将一次性解析的开销降至最低。

items.source: Graal Native Image compilation requires reachability metadata for serializable TypedPropertyPath lambdas. Spring Data ships a built-in feature through org.springframework.data.core.TypedPropertyPathFeature. The feature is auto-activated and registers required serialization- and reflection metadata for lambda parsing and referenced reflective members (fields and methods). Note also, when using lambda expressions instead of method references you will have to include the Java source code of the class containing the lambda expression in the native image configuration yourself.
items.translation: Graal Native Image 编译需要为可序列化的 TypedPropertyPath lambda 提供可达性元数据。Spring Data 通过 org.springframework.data.core.TypedPropertyPathFeature 提供了一个内置的 特性。该特性会自动激活，并为 lambda 解析和引用的反射成员（字段和方法）注册所需的序列化及反射元数据。请注意，如果使用 lambda 表达式而非方法引用，您必须自行在原生镜像配置中包含包含该 lambda 表达式的类的 Java 源代码。
